title: Teamwork and conflict
intro: When asked about conflict, show that you disagreed respectfully, listened, and found a solution together.
introTamil: Conflict பற்றிக் கேட்டால், மரியாதையுடன் கருத்து வேறுபட்டீர்கள், கவனமாகக் கேட்டீர்கள், சேர்ந்து தீர்வு கண்டீர்கள் என்று காட்டுங்கள்.

phrases.text: We had a disagreement about whether to release before the testing was complete.
phrases.tamil: Testing முடிவதற்கு முன் release செய்யலாமா என்பதில் எங்களுக்குள் கருத்து வேறுபாடு இருந்தது.
phrases.note: Describe the issue, not the person.

phrases.text: I listened to understand his point of view first.
phrases.tamil: முதலில் அவருடைய கருத்தைப் புரிந்துகொள்ள கவனமாகக் கேட்டேன்.
phrases.note: Interviewers want to see that you listen before you argue.

phrases.text: I suggested we release the core features first and the rest a week later.
phrases.tamil: முக்கிய features-ஐ முதலில் release செய்து, மீதியை ஒரு வாரம் கழித்து release செய்யலாம் என்று பரிந்துரைத்தேன்.
phrases.note: After "suggested", use "we" + base verb: "I suggested we release…"

phrases.text: We looked at the defect data together instead of arguing.
phrases.tamil: வாதம் செய்வதற்குப் பதிலாக, defect data-வை சேர்ந்து பார்த்தோம்.
phrases.note: Data turns a personal argument into a team decision.

phrases.text: In the end, we agreed on a plan, and we still work well together.
phrases.tamil: கடைசியில் ஒரு plan-க்கு ஒப்புக்கொண்டோம்; இப்போதும் நாங்கள் நன்றாகச் சேர்ந்து வேலை செய்கிறோம்.
phrases.note: End on a positive note about the working relationship.

steps.prompt: The interviewer asks: "Tell me about a time you disagreed with a colleague." Which answer is best?
steps.promptTamil: Interviewer "ஒரு colleague-உடன் கருத்து வேறுபட்ட ஒரு சந்தர்ப்பத்தைச் சொல்லுங்கள்" என்கிறார். எந்த பதில் சிறந்தது?
options: I never had any conflict with anyone.
We had a disagreement about whether to release before the testing was complete.
My team lead was wrong, so I escalated to the manager.
steps.answer: We had a disagreement about whether to release before the testing was complete.
steps.explanation: Give a real, work-related disagreement; "never" sounds unrealistic and blaming sounds negative.
steps.explanationTamil: வேலை தொடர்பான உண்மையான கருத்து வேறுபாட்டைச் சொல்லுங்கள். "Never" நம்பும்படி இல்லை; பிறரைக் குறை சொல்வது negative-ஆகத் தெரியும்.

steps.promptTamil: வாதம் செய்வதற்குப் பதிலாக, defect data-வை சேர்ந்து பார்த்தோம்.
steps.answer: We looked at the defect data together instead of arguing.

steps.audioText: I listened to understand his point of view first.
options: I listened to understand his point of view later.
I wanted to understand this point of view first.
I listened to understand his point of view first.
steps.answer: I listened to understand his point of view first.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I suggested him to release the core features first.
options: I suggested him to release the core features first.
I suggested that we release the core features first.
I suggested to him to release the core features first.
I suggested him that we release the core features first.
steps.answer: I suggested that we release the core features first.
steps.explanation: Don't say "suggested him to"; say "I suggested that we…" or "I suggested releasing…".
steps.explanationTamil: "Suggested him to" தவறு. "I suggested that we…" என்று சொல்லுங்கள்.

steps.prompt: How do you end your conflict story? Which answer is best?
steps.promptTamil: உங்கள் conflict கதையை எப்படி முடிப்பீர்கள்? எந்த பதில் சிறந்தது?
options: Finally, he accepted that I was correct.
After that, I stopped talking to him about it.
In the end, we agreed on a plan, and we still work well together.
steps.answer: In the end, we agreed on a plan, and we still work well together.
steps.explanation: A good ending shows a shared decision and a healthy working relationship.
steps.explanationTamil: சேர்ந்து எடுத்த முடிவும் நல்ல வேலை உறவும் தெரியும்படி முடிப்பது சிறந்தது.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: He was not agreeing for my idea.
options: He was not agreeing for my idea.
He didn't agree with my idea.
He was not agreeing with my idea only.
He didn't agreed to my idea.
steps.answer: He didn't agree with my idea.
steps.explanation: Use the simple past "didn't agree", and say "agree with" an idea or a person.
steps.explanationTamil: Simple past-இல் "didn't agree" என்று சொல்லுங்கள். ஒரு கருத்துக்கு "agree for" அல்ல, "agree with" வரும்.

steps.promptTamil: முக்கிய features-ஐ முதலில் release செய்து, மீதியை ஒரு வாரம் கழித்து release செய்யலாம் என்று பரிந்துரைத்தேன்.
steps.answer: I suggested we release the core features first and the rest a week later.

steps.audioText: We had a disagreement about whether to release before the testing was complete.
options: We had a disagreement about whether to release before the testing was complete.
We had a disagreement about whether to release after the testing was complete.
We had an agreement about when to release before the testing was complete.
steps.answer: We had a disagreement about whether to release before the testing was complete.

steps.prompt: Describe a real disagreement from your work out loud in 4–5 sentences: what it was about, how you listened, what you suggested, and how it ended.
steps.promptTamil: உங்கள் வேலையில் நடந்த ஒரு உண்மையான கருத்து வேறுபாட்டை 4–5 வாக்கியங்களில் சத்தமாகச் சொல்லுங்கள்: எதைப் பற்றி, எப்படிக் கேட்டீர்கள், என்ன பரிந்துரைத்தீர்கள், எப்படி முடிந்தது.
